projects.name: CodeNiti AI
projects.description: A code-review workbench combining AI-assisted developer tools with deterministic static checks, authentication, caching and report history.
projects.problem: Developers need to review code quality, spot common security issues and understand proposed changes without relying on AI suggestions alone.
projects.approach: FastAPI endpoints combine code-analysis utilities, bounded caching, account-scoped history and AI-assisted suggestions.
projects.outcome: Working academic prototype with automated checks; review the source and README for limitations.

projects.name: ClassLens
projects.description: A role-based attendance platform with camera-assisted recognition, teacher review flows, subject tracking and student dashboards.
projects.problem: Manual lecture attendance takes time and is hard to audit when errors occur.
projects.approach: React dashboards, FastAPI services, OpenCV-assisted recognition and a teacher verification workflow.
projects.outcome: Role-based prototype with backend and browser tests; recognition accuracy is not independently claimed.

projects.name: Dharti Rakshak
projects.description: A multilingual farming companion for managing advisory checks, field records, cash flows and local marketplace activity.
projects.problem: Farmers need a simple place to track fields, tasks, market listings and day-to-day financial records.
projects.approach: Python/Flask with multilingual interfaces, advisory checks and farmer/buyer workflows.
projects.outcome: Demonstration application; advisory content is not a substitute for local agricultural expertise.
